focus.zh: 台灣與東南亞半導體、伺服器及工業設備供應鏈
focus.en: Taiwan and Southeast Asian semiconductor, server and industrial-equipment supply chains

throughline.zh: 馬來西亞查核資料中心 AI 晶片流向，台灣同時發布伺服器財報、電子資訊採購預估及電源與高速材料製造計畫。
throughline.en: Malaysia is investigating the movement of AI chips through data centers, while Taiwan reported server earnings, electronics procurement forecasts, and plans for power and high-speed materials.

text.zh: 馬來西亞投貿部查核 Speedmatrix 晶片是否再出口；官員場勘並未構成核准，尚無違規調查結論。
text.en: Malaysia is checking whether Speedmatrix chips were re-exported; prior site visits were not clearance and no violation has been established.

text.zh: 華碩第三季營收 2,587.88 億元、年增 36%；伺服器營收年增約一倍，全年成長預測仍待實現。
text.en: ASUS reported NT$258.788 billion Q3 revenue, up 36% YoY, and roughly doubled server sales; full-year growth remains guidance.

text.zh: 經濟部預估 2026 年外商對台電子資訊採購 3,258 億美元、年增 24%，屬預測值。
text.en: MOEA forecasts US$325.8 billion in 2026 electronics procurement from Taiwan, up 24%, with the figure explicitly an estimate.

text.zh: 新加坡警方新增伺服器採購案件被告，指控涉及 917 台伺服器的歷史交易，案件尚待審理。
text.en: Singapore added defendants in a case involving allegations over 917 historical server units; the charges remain unproven.

text.zh: 元太與台虹合作高速 PTFE 材料，預期 2027 年小量生產、2028 年量產，客戶驗證未完成。
text.en: E Ink and Taiflex target limited PTFE output in 2027 and mass production in 2028, subject to qualification.

title.zh: 追蹤：馬來西亞查 Speedmatrix AI 晶片再出口，投貿部澄清未核准相關業者
title.en: Follow-up: Malaysia checks Speedmatrix AI-chip re-exports and denies granting clearance

summary.zh: 馬來西亞投資、貿易及工業部 11 月 13 日表示，正與海關查核 Speedmatrix 帶入當地資料中心的 AI 晶片是否曾再出口，並澄清先前例行場勘不構成核准。當局稱自 2025 年 7 月起，特定美國高效能 AI 晶片的出口、再出口或轉運須取得許可；目前尚無已證實的違規出貨結論。
summary.en: Malaysia's Investment, Trade and Industry Ministry said on November 13 it was checking with customs whether AI chips brought into local data centers by Speedmatrix were re-exported, clarifying that routine site visits did not constitute clearance. Export, re-export and transit of specified US high-performance AI chips have required permits since July 2025; the ministry has not established a violation.

text.zh: Speedmatrix 為新加坡 Megaspeed 在馬來西亞的關係企業，投貿部表示該公司以資料中心租戶身分自帶伺服器與 AI 晶片。政府區分一般進口與受管制晶片再出口：現行進口不必取得特別許可，但特定跨境移轉涉及戰略貿易法規。
text.en: Speedmatrix is linked to Singapore-based Megaspeed and, according to the ministry, brought its own servers and AI chips to rented Malaysian data-center facilities. The ministry distinguishes chip imports, which currently need no special import permit, from controlled re-export and transit under strategic-trade rules.

text.zh: 馬來西亞通訊社 Bernama 引述投貿部當日聲明，部會未對 Megaspeed 或 Speedmatrix 作出公司層級核准，先前檢查資料中心屬一般監測。投貿部與皇家海關調查相關晶片的後續去向，並與新加坡、美國相關單位合作。
text.en: Bernama reported the ministry's November 13 statement that neither Megaspeed nor Speedmatrix had received company-specific clearance and that prior inspections were routine. The ministry and Royal Malaysian Customs are examining subsequent chip movements while cooperating with counterparts in Singapore and the United States.

label.zh: 不同官方表述及證據界線

text.zh: 總理安華同日對媒體表示，當時沒有跡象顯示相關晶片已從馬來西亞出口，也沒有接獲新加坡或美國的正式協助調查請求。投貿部所說的跨境合作與總理所說的未收到正式請求，屬不同程序描述；目前都不能據此推定交易合法或違法。
text.en: Prime Minister Anwar Ibrahim said the same day there was no indication the chips had been exported from Malaysia and no formal assistance request from Singapore or the United States at that point. The ministry's reference to cooperation and the prime minister's statement about formal requests concern different processes; neither settles compliance.

text.zh: 晶片型號、數量、各批貨物流向、海關申報、許可文件及調查結論尚未公開；本事件不等同已查證的晶片轉運或定罪。
text.en: Chip models, units, shipment routes, customs filings, permits and investigation findings remain undisclosed. No unlawful diversion or conviction has been established.

ceoView.en: For suppliers of server power, precision measurement and data-center controls, this inquiry raises questions about customs declarations and end-use records when customer equipment crosses borders. Specific chip classifications, shipment records and compliance findings are still needed before drawing conclusions about equipment demand.

title.zh: 華碩第三季營收 2,587.88 億元，伺服器業務年增約一倍
title.en: ASUS reports NT$258.788 billion Q3 revenue and roughly doubled server sales

summary.zh: 華碩 11 月 12 日晚間公布第三季營收 2,587.88 億元、年增 36%，營業利益 219.64 億元、年增 161%，歸母淨利 216.31 億元、年增 105%。公司表示第三季伺服器營收年增約 100%，全年成長至少 150% 仍屬管理階層展望，未提供伺服器台數與個別電源設備訂單。
summary.en: ASUS reported Q3 revenue of NT$258.788 billion on November 12, up 36% YoY, operating profit of NT$21.964 billion, up 161%, and attributable profit of NT$21.631 billion, up 105%. Management said server revenue roughly doubled in Q3 and guided to at least 150% full-year growth, without disclosing server unit shipments or separate power-equipment orders.

text.zh: 華碩經營品牌電腦、伺服器與整機系統，其 AI 與一般型伺服器使用晶片、記憶體、電源供應及散熱零組件。公司整體營收無法拆解為 AI 機櫃、測試設備或特定客戶驗收金額。
text.en: ASUS sells PCs, servers and complete systems. AI and conventional servers combine processors, memory, power conversion and cooling. Consolidated group revenue cannot identify AI-rack units, test-equipment purchases or individual customer acceptances.

text.zh: 中央社根據華碩法人說明會整理，第三季營收較前季增加 7%，營益增加 12%，歸母淨利增加 14%，每股盈餘為 29.1 元。年增率分別為營收 36%、營益 161%、歸母淨利 105%，季增與年增比較基準不同，不應混用。
text.en: CNA reported quarter-on-quarter increases of 7% in revenue, 12% in operating profit and 14% in attributable profit, with EPS of NT$29.1. The corresponding year-on-year growth figures were 36%, 161% and 105%; those comparisons use different bases.

text.zh: 管理階層稱第三季伺服器營收年增約 100%，通用型 CPU 伺服器年增 80%、約占伺服器營收 20%。全年伺服器營收至少成長 150% 為公司預期；2027 年高雙位數成長為內部目標，部分第三季認列受客戶部署時間影響。
text.en: Management said server revenue rose about 100% YoY in Q3, conventional CPU-server sales rose 80% and represented roughly 20% of server revenue. At least 150% growth for full-year 2026 is guidance, while high-double-digit growth for 2027 is an internal target. Some quarterly recognition was delayed by customer deployment schedules.

text.zh: 沒有公布 AI 與通用伺服器各自精確營收、出貨台數、機櫃額定功率、液冷規格與已簽妥的 2027 年訂單數量。
text.en: Precise AI-versus-CPU server revenue, unit shipments, rack power ratings, liquid-cooling specifications and firm 2027 order quantities were not disclosed.

title.zh: 經濟部估 2026 年外商對台電子資訊採購 3,258 億美元，年增 24%
title.en: Taiwan MOEA forecasts US$325.8 billion electronics procurement in 2026, up 24%

summary.zh: 經濟部 11 月 12 日於電子資訊國際夥伴績優廠商頒獎活動公布，預估 2026 年國際大廠對台採購金額達 3,258 億美元，年增 24%。此數據屬年度預估，涵蓋電子資訊跨公司採購，不能直接等同已完成出口、個別伺服器訂單或晶片出貨。
summary.en: Taiwan's Ministry of Economic Affairs said on November 12 it expected international electronics and IT procurement from Taiwan to reach US$325.8 billion in 2026, 24% above the previous year. The figure is a ministry forecast spanning cross-company procurement, not confirmed exports, individual server orders or chip shipments.

label.zh: 供應鏈背景與統計範圍

text.zh: 經濟部在 11 月 11 日舉行的 IPO Awards 活動表揚 ASML、NVIDIA、Apple 等 22 家國際業者，隔日發布採購預估。涵蓋電子資訊國際採購鏈，包括晶圓、設備、零組件、伺服器、供電和散熱等產業關聯，但新聞稿沒有揭露逐公司金額。
text.en: The ministry held its IPO Awards event on November 11 and issued the forecast on November 12, recognizing 22 international firms including ASML, NVIDIA and Apple. The procurement ecosystem spans semiconductors, equipment, components, servers, power and cooling, but no company-level procurement breakdown was released.

label.zh: 預估與已實現數據分開

text.zh: 經濟部稱 2026 年採購規模預估 3,258 億美元、年增 24%。同篇另引述前九月台灣累計出口 6,615.3 億美元、年增 46.2%；出口統計與對台採購預估的定義、期間和母體不同，無法相加或直接比較。
text.en: The ministry forecast 2026 procurement of US$325.8 billion, up 24% YoY. The same release cited US$661.53 billion of Taiwan exports in the first nine months, up 46.2%; trade exports and projected international procurement differ in definition, period and reporting population and should not be added together.

label.zh: 供電與設備供應鏈資料

text.zh: 同一公告提及伊頓近兩年在台擴產投資逾 2 億元，並稱規劃未來四年投入 3 億元發展高壓直流供電及液冷；科磊在新竹設立技術訓練中心。這些是個別企業投資與設施資訊，不能視為 3,258 億美元採購預估的分項證明。
text.en: The release separately described more than NT$200 million of Eaton expansion spending over the previous two years, a planned NT$300 million over four more years for high-voltage DC power and liquid cooling, and a KLA training center in Hsinchu. These company-level details do not constitute a breakdown of the US$325.8 billion procurement forecast.

text.zh: 尚無可核對的逐買主採購數字、預估計算明細、實際交貨或驗收金額，也未提供同口徑前一年精確採購基數。
text.en: Buyer-level amounts, forecasting methodology, delivered and accepted value, and an exact comparable prior-year procurement base were not released.

title.zh: 元太與台虹合作 PTFE 高速傳輸材料，稱 2027 年先小量生產
title.en: E Ink and Taiflex develop PTFE high-speed materials, targeting initial 2027 output

summary.zh: 元太 11 月 12 日法說表示，將與台虹合作開發用於 AI 資料中心的 PTFE 高速傳輸材料，規劃利用觀音廠既有廠務與捲對捲設備資源，預計 2027 年初步生產、2028 年量產。元太持有台虹約 15.7% 股權，量產與客戶認證目前都屬後續計畫。
summary.en: At its November 12 investor briefing, E Ink said it was jointly developing PTFE high-speed transmission materials with Taiflex for AI data centers, potentially using existing roll-to-roll resources at its Guanyin facility. Initial production is targeted for 2027 and mass production for 2028; E Ink holds about 15.7% of Taiflex, while customer qualification remains pending.

text.zh: PTFE 聚四氟乙烯可用於高速傳輸材料開發，供應鏈涉及基板材料、電子零組件、伺服器及資料中心系統。元太表示電子紙與相關材料加工都有捲對捲製程，可能共用或調整部分製造資源。
text.en: PTFE is under development for high-speed transmission materials used in electronics supply chains spanning substrates, server components and data-center systems. E Ink said its e-paper and proposed PTFE processes both use roll-to-roll methods, allowing potential shared or adapted resources.

text.zh: 元太第三季營收 99.36 億元、年減 5%，歸母淨利 26.52 億元；前九月營收 287.9 億元。材料業務初步貢獻預期落在 2027 年，2028 年量產尚待製程、良率及客戶驗證。
text.en: E Ink reported Q3 revenue of NT$9.936 billion, down 5% YoY, attributable profit of NT$2.652 billion, and nine-month revenue of NT$28.79 billion. Initial contribution in 2027 and mass production in 2028 depend on process readiness, yields and customer qualification.

text.zh: 目前沒有公開材料月產能、驗證客戶、已簽訂單、正式規格或專屬 PTFE 營收。
text.en: Material capacity, qualification customers, contracted orders, finalized specifications and stand-alone PTFE revenue were not disclosed.

title.zh: 新加坡警方新增伺服器採購詐欺案被告，指涉 917 台伺服器交易
title.en: Singapore charges more defendants in server procurement case involving 917 units

summary.zh: 新加坡警方 11 月 13 日公告，伺服器採購涉嫌不實陳述及洗錢案件新增一人與兩家公司遭起訴。警方指控兩家公司於 2024 年 5 月至 2025 年 2 月間，透過 41 筆交易取得共 917 台伺服器；此為起訴內容，尚非已判決成立的事實。
summary.en: Singapore Police announced on November 13 that one additional individual and two companies had been charged in an ongoing server procurement fraud and money-laundering case. Prosecutors allege 41 transactions involving 917 servers between May 2024 and February 2025; these are allegations, not findings of guilt.

text.zh: 警方公告指案件涉及 Aperia International 的伺服器交易與涉嫌虛假陳述，新增被告涉及 Superphi 和 NJ Global。所列伺服器數量反映遭調查的歷史交易範圍，不能直接用作近期伺服器銷量。
text.en: Police described transactions involving Aperia International and alleged fraudulent representations, with new charges involving Superphi and NJ Global. The cited server units relate to historical transactions under investigation and cannot be treated as current server sales.

text.zh: 警方稱新增一名個人面臨 41 項相關指控，兩家公司分別被控 6 項及 35 項；截至 11 月 13 日，全案共有五人及六家公司遭起訴。案件調查中的數字與刑事指控尚待司法審理。
text.en: The newly charged individual faces 41 counts; the two companies face six and 35 counts respectively. As of November 13, five people and six companies had been charged across the case. Transaction counts and allegations await judicial resolution.

text.zh: 法院尚未就本次新增被告的指控作出有罪裁決，警方公告也未將這 917 台伺服器與馬來西亞調查所涉晶片建立證據連結。
text.en: The newly announced charges have not resulted in convictions, and the police notice does not establish an evidentiary link between these servers and Malaysia's chip inquiry.

title.zh: 電電公會公布波蘭產業日參展名單，逾 50 家台廠 11 月 17 日起展示供應鏈
title.en: TEEMA names over 50 Taiwan exhibitors for Warsaw industry days opening November 17

summary.zh: 台灣電電公會 11 月 13 日宣布，超過 50 家台灣業者將參加波蘭華沙的 TEEMA 科學園區產業日，展示 AI 資料中心機櫃、液冷、智慧電力及工業設備。主辦官網列出 11 月 17 至 18 日在 Hilton Warsaw Hotel 舉行，參展公告尚未提供已簽訂採購合約金額。
summary.en: Taiwan's electrical and electronics association said on November 13 that over 50 Taiwan companies would exhibit AI data-center racks, liquid cooling, smart energy and industrial equipment in Warsaw. The organizer lists November 17–18 at Hilton Warsaw Hotel; no signed procurement value accompanied the exhibitor announcement.

text.zh: 電電公會列出鴻海、東元、環電、旭東機械等參與業者，展品涵蓋模組化資料中心、伺服器供電與液冷、電動車零組件及精密加工設備。參展名單說明產品展示範圍，未必代表現場完成設備銷售。
text.en: TEEMA identified participants including Foxconn, TECO, Universal Scientific Industrial and machinery suppliers, with exhibits covering modular data centers, rack power and liquid cooling, EV components and precision machining. Exhibitor lists describe planned demonstrations, not completed sales.

text.zh: 主辦單位英文活動頁明列波蘭華沙 Hilton Warsaw Hotel，11 月 17 日與 18 日每天舉行產業論壇、技術交流與媒合活動。11 月 13 日公布的是參展安排，展會尚未開始。
text.en: The organizer's English event page names Hilton Warsaw Hotel, Warsaw, for November 17 and 18, with forums, technical sessions and business matching. The November 13 development was the exhibitor announcement; the event had not yet begun.

text.en: Signed contracts, equipment acceptance, exhibitor sales values and subsequent Polish investment commitments were not disclosed.

title.zh: 高雄亞灣公布 25 家新創 AI 實證成果，涵蓋車用電子及工廠排程
title.en: Kaohsiung Asia New Bay showcases 25 startups' industrial AI pilots

summary.zh: 經濟部中小及新創企業署 11 月 13 日在高雄亞灣新創園展示 25 家新創 AI 實證成果，應用包括車用電子、塑橡膠化工、食品加工與物流調度。主辦報名頁詳細場次列高雄市成功二路 25 號，但頁面上方地區欄誤列臺北市大安區，場地依逐場地址與活動內容標示。
summary.en: Taiwan's Small and Medium Enterprise and Startup Administration showcased industrial AI pilots from 25 startups on November 13 at the Asia New Bay startup campus in Kaohsiung, spanning automotive electronics, plastics, food processing and logistics. The organizer's detailed session addresses identify Kaohsiung, although its summary location field incorrectly says Taipei.

label.zh: 工廠自動化與實證內容

text.zh: 經濟部表示，計畫媒合企業與新創測試機台參數、品質檢測及生產排程等應用。中央社引述案例包括富強鑫設備參數分析時間由 2.5 小時降至 10 分鐘，以及大武山牧場供貨調配由每日 4 小時縮至 1.2 小時；這是特定場域回報數值，未公布全產業統計。
text.en: The ministry described pilot applications in machine parameters, quality inspection and production scheduling. CNA reported examples in which FCS machinery analysis fell from 2.5 hours to 10 minutes and a food producer's daily delivery allocation from four hours to 1.2 hours. These are specific pilot claims, not industry-wide statistics.

text.zh: 主辦活動頁列明 11 月 13 日上午及下午場次位於高雄市前鎮區成功二路 25 號、亞灣新創園 3 樓與 8 樓；頁面頂端的地區標籤卻寫臺北市大安區。場次明細及中央社報導皆指向高雄，兩者差異仍保留供讀者辨識。
text.en: The organizer's session details place the November 13 morning and afternoon program at No. 25, Chenggong 2nd Road, Cianjhen District, Kaohsiung, on floors 3 and 8 of the Asia New Bay startup campus. Its summary location field says Da'an District, Taipei; the detailed addresses and CNA report point to Kaohsiung.

text.zh: 25 家新創各自的實際商用部署規模、付費客戶、設備採購與長期績效尚無完整公開數據。
text.en: Commercial deployment scale, paying customers, equipment purchases and long-term outcomes for all 25 startups remain undisclosed.

title.zh: 經濟部揭露伊頓在台逾 2 億元既有投資，未來四年規劃再投入 3 億元
title.en: MOEA cites Eaton's NT$200m-plus Taiwan expansion and NT$300m four-year plan

summary.zh: 經濟部 11 月 12 日指出，伊頓近兩年已在台擴產投資逾新台幣 2 億元，並表示未來四年將再投入 3 億元，布局高壓直流供電與液冷散熱。前者為政府引述的過去投資，後者屬未來規劃，尚未揭露新增產線產能或已完成設備驗收。
summary.en: Taiwan's Ministry of Economic Affairs said on November 12 that Eaton had invested more than NT$200 million in local expansion over the previous two years and planned another NT$300 million over four years for high-voltage DC power and liquid cooling. The first figure concerns reported past spending, while the second is a forward plan, with no new capacity or equipment acceptance data.

text.zh: 資料中心高壓直流供電與液冷系統涉及電力轉換、功率控制、冷卻機組與機櫃整合，與台灣伺服器及電源零組件產業相連。經濟部將伊頓列為外商在台擴產與技術投入案例。
text.en: High-voltage DC distribution and liquid cooling involve power conversion, control, cooling units and rack integration linked to Taiwanese server and electrical components. MOEA cited Eaton as an example of local expansion and technology investment by an international company.

text.zh: 官方新聞稿稱近兩年在台擴產投資超過 2 億元，未來四年規劃另投入 3 億元。兩筆數字期間不同，未確認是否有明確的逐年預算或新廠資產明細，也不可與同篇電子資訊採購額直接相加。
text.en: The ministry cited more than NT$200 million in spending over two years and a separate planned NT$300 million over the next four years. Annual allocations and plant-level asset details were not provided. The amounts should not be added to the ministry's broader electronics procurement forecast.

text.zh: 未公布高壓直流產品規格、已安裝功率、液冷量產量、驗收客戶或細項資金分配。
text.en: No HVDC product ratings, installed power, liquid-cooling production volume, customer acceptances or project-level spending breakdown was disclosed.

question.zh: 馬來西亞調查是否已證實晶片違規出口？
question.en: Has Malaysia established unlawful chip re-exports?

text.zh: 沒有。投貿部仍在與海關檢查交易及許可文件，總理表示當時無出口跡象。既有再出口許可規範自 2025 年 7 月生效。
text.en: No. The ministry and customs are reviewing shipment and permit records, while the prime minister said there was no indication of export at that time. The existing permit requirement dates from July 2025.

question.zh: 華碩第三季伺服器營收年增一倍，是否表示出貨台數翻倍？
question.en: Does ASUS doubling server revenue mean units doubled?

text.zh: 公司公告的是營收成長，未公布同口徑出貨台數、產品單價或 AI 機櫃驗收數量。全年成長至少 150% 也仍是公司展望。
text.en: Management disclosed revenue growth, not comparable unit shipments, product prices or accepted AI-rack counts. The at-least-150% full-year figure also remains guidance.

question.zh: 經濟部 3,258 億美元對台採購與前九月出口數字能相加嗎？
question.en: Can MOEA's procurement forecast be added to nine-month exports?

text.zh: 不能。兩者統計母體、期間及定義不同：前者是全年國際採購預估，後者是前九月出口實績。政府未公布可逐項對照的買主別明細。
text.en: No. The two measures differ by population, period and definition: projected annual international procurement versus recorded nine-month exports. Buyer-level reconciliation was not published.

title.zh: 採購預估與營收指引口徑

text.zh: 經濟部的電子資訊採購額是 2026 年全年預估，華碩第三季營收是已公布的季報數字；不同統計範圍與期間不可直接相加比較。
text.en: MOEA's procurement amount is a full-year 2026 forecast, while ASUS reports realized quarterly revenue. Different definitions and periods prevent direct aggregation.

text.zh: 未重刊 11 月 13 日版已有的南亞玻纖布、三井金屬馬來西亞銅箔及鴻海第三季財報；本次僅新增可追溯的揭露。
text.en: Previously covered Nanya fiberglass, Mitsui's Malaysia copper-foil project and Foxconn's Q3 results were not repeated without new verified disclosures.

verificationNote.zh: 馬來西亞晶片去向仍在調查，部會聲明由當地媒體引述，尚未取得原始申報文件或已確認的非法再出口證據。高雄 AI 活動報名頁上方地區欄與正式場次地址不一致，文章採詳細場次地址並保留差異。年度採購、未來生產與供電擴產計畫均為預估或規劃。
verificationNote.en: The Malaysian chip inquiry is unresolved; local outlets reproduce the ministry statement but underlying customs records and evidence of unlawful re-export have not been published. The Kaohsiung event's summary location conflicts with its detailed addresses; the edition uses the specific venue and flags the discrepancy. Procurement, production and power-expansion plans remain forecasts or targets.
